description: This file defines an interface 'IActivationRebalancer' for interacting with an activation rebalancer component in Orleans, including methods for obtaining reports, controlling rebalancing, and managing subscriptions.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancer
classes.description: An interface providing methods for managing and monitoring activation rebalancing in Orleans.

methods.name: GetRebalancingReport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a rebalancing report, with an option to force the retrieval, potentially incurring additional latency.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends the activation rebalancing process for an optional duration.

methods.name: SubscribeToReports
methods.description: Subscribes a listener to receive rebalancer reports.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromReports
methods.description: Unsubscribes a listener from receiving rebalancer reports.
